item.description:
SnackTray 1.2.0

  • ### Added
  • Keep a window in front. Hold your snap modifier and right-click a window's title bar,
  • then choose Pin to Front, and that window stays visible while you work in other apps.
  • Unpin it from the window itself, the same title bar menu, or the SnackTray menu. There
  • is also a shortcut, Shift Control P by default. Needs Screen Recording access, and works
  • on the Space the window lives on. Off by default, under Behavior then Experimental.
  • ### Changed
  • SnackTray now requires macOS 14 or later.
  • Window previews on Dock hover now update live rather than showing a still picture taken
  • when the pointer arrived. A video, a terminal or a build log shows what it is doing.
  • Previews still appear instantly from the last picture while the live view starts.
  • Update alerts are easier to notice. SnackTray runs in the menu bar with no Dock icon, so
  • an update found in the background could open behind whatever you were working in. The
  • menu bar icon now carries a dot and the menu reads Update Available until you look.
